# Northvale Bicycles on Trains

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software evaluation; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 When bicycles are allowed

Bicycles are allowed on trains outside peak hours. Peak hours are 7:00 to 9:00 and 16:00 to 18:00 on weekdays.

## 2 Folding bicycles

Folded bicycles are allowed at all times.
